purpose: Simulator scheduler + authenticated Sensor Control API for separate Simulator UI; durable per-machine state/sequence/spool.
interfaces: Sensor Control API for Simulator UI
boundaries: Single controller with local persistent SQLite/WAL state, durable sequence/spool/receipts; process lock and Recreate required; no multi-controller HA claim.
SensorRequest wire1.3.0 and HTTP202 ACK; Control baseline1.3.2 authenticated/scoped; no inference/risk/alert work.
Independent UI, same five closed Control operations; live rate/counters/preview require a reviewed contract extension.
